name: Nagaoka Sakiko
source:
[url=/c34597]Nagaoka So'un's[/url] mother. The daughter of a wealthy businessman.

Deeply loved her husband [url=/c165927]Nagaoka Takeyuki[/url].

[Spoiler]Assassinated by [url=/c165294]Pavlov[/url], acting on [url=/c34604]Milgram's[/url] orders, at the end of the Sino-American War.

Resurrected as a living dead by Milgram after Takeyuki begged him to give her back to him.[/spoiler]
